7e1dfd82ff94b3a1.title: Simulating protein evolution with programmable fitness objectives derived from modern protein models
digest: Simulation of protein sequence evolution provides a controlled way to test whether specified evolutionary mechanisms can generate the patterns observed in natural proteins.

However, classical simulation largely relies on fixed substitution rules, whereas existing fitness-based simulations often define fitness using a single proxy and thus do not sufficiently capture the complex nature of constraints imposed by selection.
